title: Missed Every Gold Rush? This One Started Just 2 Days Ago
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Get my 242 favorite business ideas for 2025, with full launch plans included here: https://tkopod.co/youtubeD

I sat down with Jacob Posel right after OpenAI launched their image generation API, literally the same day, and we talked about the massive wave of opportunity that’s about to hit. If you’ve got a laptop, internet, and time, now’s your moment.

Jacob shared two main paths to make money fast with AI images. We explored how fun and simple image ideas can turn into real businesses, and how most people still don’t even know what these tools can do. 

Jacob explained how to launch fast, how to pitch to ad agencies, and why offering this as a white-labeled service could be a game changer. I even bought a domain live during the episode, right in the middle of the conversation.

You can follow Jacob on ( X: https://x.com/jacob_posel ) or find him on ( https://www.linkedin.com/in/jacob-posel/ ). 
If you're building something cool, reach out. He wants to see it.
